description: This file defines the AppConfiguration class, which manages application properties for the web utility in the project. It provides methods to get and set Properties and to retrieve individual property values, with logging for missing properties.

classes.name: AppConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring component class for managing application configuration properties, providing methods to access and modify properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the Properties object containing all configuration properties.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object for application configuration.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific property by key; logs a warning if properties are not loaded.
